description: Users cannot authenticate to ERP system. Ticket correlated with previous auth incident from two weeks ago, triggering high recurrence score.

expected_decision.root_cause_hypothesis: LDAP connection pool exhaustion. Recurrence of INC-2023-156 (same server, same symptom).
expected_decision.recommendation: Restart LDAP connection pool. Schedule capacity review. Route to identity team.

correlation.correlation_reason: Same LDAP server, same connection pool exhaustion symptom, 14 days apart

expected_feedback.note: Priority increased to critical. This is the third recurrence. We need to migrate to new LDAP cluster.

resolution.summary: Connection pool restarted. Users can authenticate. Migration to LDAP cluster scheduled for next maintenance window.
